description: Differential oracle for matrix/matrix_integer.ts, matrix_modn.ts, matrix_mod2.ts, matrix_decompositions.ts and matrix_operations.ts. Cases deliberately target the shapes the port has historically been wrong on: charpoly sign, kernels whose pivot columns are not 0..r-1, minimal polynomials of non-cyclic matrices, and Smith forms with repeated / non-squarefree divisors.
